questions.stem_text: The version of utilitarianism that Brandt defends makes rightness a function of:

options.A: the amount of harm caused by an action.
options.B: whether or not one's maxim can be universalized.
options.C: the moral character of the person performing the action.
options.D: the distribution of wealth in society.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the amount of harm caused by an action.

questions.stem_text: Mill claims that the principle of utility:

options.A: can only be proven through extensive observation and study.
options.B: can be proven from principles that are known empirically.
options.C: can be proven, but only under certain conditions.
options.D: is inherently flawed and therefore cannot be proven.
options.E: is a theory that has been widely disproven.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - can only be proven through extensive observation and study.
